tools.name: add_product_to_cart
tools.description: Add one in-stock simple product or exact variation returned by search_products to this browser session. Changes only the cart; never checks out, pays or reads orders.

product_ref.description: Opaque product reference returned by search_products.

tools.name: get_product_details
tools.description: Read public details for one search result. When cart_eligible is true, pass its product_ref to add_product_to_cart. Does not read accounts or orders.

product_ref.description: Opaque product reference returned by search_products.

tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Search the public ElfbarPods catalog. Each result includes a product_ref. When cart_eligible is true, pass that reference to add_product_to_cart.

query.description: Product name, brand, flavor or other public catalog term.

page.description: Zero-based result page. Refine the query when more than 21 pages are needed.
